statement: Every external submission MUST have a durable unique attempt.
Same key with changed payload MUST be rejected.
Post-submit timeout MUST become `unknown`.
Unknown attempts MUST use authoritative lookup and MUST NOT be blindly resubmitted.
Webhooks MUST be authenticated, deduplicated, and disorder-tolerant.
Adapter state MUST map without discarding rail-specific uncertainty or finality.
Adapter/network/provider changes MUST invalidate certification.
Refund, reversal, dispute, and cancellation capabilities MUST be explicitly declared.
Silent provider, rail, network, asset, or destination substitution MUST be prohibited.
Adapter I/O MUST begin only from a durable `dispatching` lease with exact request and provider identity.
Approval MUST bind to the exact immutable action and authority context.
One grant MUST be consumed at most once.
Material action changes MUST invalidate approval and grant.
Required maker/checker or quorum MUST use distinct eligible principals.
Emergency stop MUST synchronously deny new grants in scope.
Authorization-ready, dispatching, submitted, and unknown work MUST retain its exposure record and remain reconcilable after stop.
Approval routing, escalation, delegation, and expiry MUST be deterministic and evidenced.
Safe reopen MUST require reconciliation and evidence integrity.
Financial grant consumption MUST atomically create its held reservation and durable payment attempt.
Certificate MUST identify the complete adapter tuple.
Adapter MUST pass post-submit ambiguity and duplicate-effect tests.
External truth and internal ledger MUST reconcile.
Mainnet MUST have its own low-limit canary.
Material provider/network change MUST revoke certificate.
Unsupported operations MUST be explicit.
Operational and escalation owner MUST be named.
Every financial journey MUST be reconstructable end to end.
Integrity verification MUST detect modification, gaps, forks, and tail deletion.
Evidence MUST bind to exact release, schema, environment, and adapter profile.
Secrets and personal payload MUST NOT be placed onchain or in immutable public proof.
Retention, legal hold, deletion, and DSAR MUST be executable and tested for every certified market profile.
Missing required evidence MUST block or revoke certification.
Evidence access and export MUST be role-, purpose-, and tenant-scoped.
An independent verifier MUST validate exported bundles without production database access.
Pseudonymous proof identifiers MUST use a reviewed keyed/random derivation and MUST NOT expose directly hashable low-entropy personal identifiers.
Every privileged human MUST have a unique account and phishing-resistant MFA.
Tenant MUST derive from authenticated context.
Money, key, destination, and policy-widening changes MUST use two distinct principals.
Invitations MUST require explicit acceptance and expire.
Joiner/mover/leaver changes MUST propagate to all sessions and dependent grants.
Access reviews MUST identify dormant, privileged, and orphaned accounts.
Emergency revocation MUST deny the next new action before returning success.
Break-glass access MUST be time-bound, notified, and fully evidenced.
State-changing commands MUST be idempotently addressable.
Organization identity MUST derive from authenticated context.
External submission MUST occur only after intent, authorization, reservation, and attempt are durable.
`EXTERNAL_UNKNOWN` MUST NOT be mapped to failure.
Event publication MUST tolerate duplicates and disorder.
Every state transition MUST emit sufficient evidence to reconstruct causality.
Breaking interface changes MUST revoke dependent certificates.
The exact external request and recovery identity MUST be durable before an attempt enters `dispatching`.
An expired `dispatching` lease MUST become `EXTERNAL_UNKNOWN` unless authoritative evidence proves no send occurred.
Control-plane commands MUST NOT require mission/delegation fields before those objects exist.
Grant consumption, reservation creation, and payment-attempt creation MUST commit atomically or remain invisible and non-executable.
Every canonical record declares one scope type: `platform`, `provider`, `tenant`, or `tenant_provider_binding`; every tenant-scoped record belongs to exactly one organization.
Every state transition has one owning domain and one idempotent command identity.
External side effects require a durable `ActionIntent`.
Destructive actions require a decision for the exact action hash.
Financial submission requires an active grant and held reservation.
One grant can be consumed at most once.
Submitted uncertainty remains `unknown` until authoritative reconciliation.
Every economic event maps to a balanced journal entry.
Every terminal journey has a sealed evidence bundle or a blocking evidence incident.
A material dependency change revokes affected certificates.
Irreversible external I/O requires a durable runtime or payment attempt in `dispatching` containing the exact request and recovery identity.
Grant consumption, financial-attempt creation, and reservation creation MUST share one atomic commit boundary before signing or dispatch.
Every economic event MUST create balanced immutable postings.
Monetary amounts MUST use exact integers and explicit asset units.
Limits MUST include settled consumption and outstanding holds.
Authorization-ready, dispatching, submitted, and unknown attempts MUST retain or quarantine reservations until authoritative resolution.
History MUST be corrected through new entries, never mutation.
Duplicate external events MUST NOT create duplicate postings.
Internal balances MUST reconcile to authoritative external truth.
Unexplained monetary difference MUST revoke affected production profile.
Full ledger rebuild MUST reproduce balances and evidence links.

Reservation release or expiry MUST require proof that no irreversible submission, economic effect, or still-valid externally executable authorization exists; quarantined reservations MUST resolve only through authoritative consume-or-release evidence.
Every supported economic event MUST map to an approved debit/credit posting rule before the adapter is certifiable.
Every production tenant MUST have an approved legal-entity/jurisdiction/use-case profile.
Provider and customer eligibility MUST be verified for the exact profile.
Custody, authorization, screening, settlement, refund, and data responsibilities MUST be explicit.
Customer terms MUST describe enforcement boundaries, exclusions, and failure handling.
A material legal/provider/data change MUST revoke or re-review the profile.
Production limits MUST match the approved maximum exposure.
Every destructive or financial action MUST reference an active immutable mission or explicit emergency operation.
Agents MUST NOT widen their mission.
Mission versions MUST include sponsor, purpose, scope, budget, expiry, approval, and evidence requirements.

Cancellation MUST distinguish unsigned, authorization-ready, dispatching, submitted, unknown, settled, and irreversible work and MUST NOT release exposed capacity without authoritative no-effect proof.
Completion MUST require all declared deterministic acceptance conditions.
External mandate artifacts MUST bind to the exact mission and action.
Material mission changes MUST run impact simulation before activation.
Production artifacts MUST be reproducible, signed, and provenance-linked.
No known exploitable Critical or High issue MAY remain on a money path at release.
Backup and isolated restore MUST meet approved RTO/RPO.
Restore MUST recover reservations, attempts, idempotency, ledger, and evidence before reopen.
Product-journey SLOs and error budgets MUST govern rollout.
Incidents MUST preserve in-flight reconciliation while stopping new authority.
Queues and workers MUST tolerate duplicates, disorder, crashes, and replay.
Material provider, network, signer, or release change MUST invalidate certification.
Every production SLI MUST define numerator, denominator, window, exclusions, threshold, burn-rate action, owner, and runbook.
Mainnet destructive and financial policy MUST deny by default.
Every decision MUST pin exact input hash, policy versions, and epoch.
Deny and hard ceilings MUST dominate narrower rules.
Financial limits MUST include outstanding reservations.
Stale policy cache or epoch MUST NOT widen authority.
Simulator and runtime evaluator MUST be equivalent.
Natural-language drafting MUST preserve source, questions, and human confirmation.
Policy widening and mainnet activation MUST use separation of duties.
Changed amount, destination, provider, request, mission, or epoch MUST invalidate the decision/grant.
Provider endpoint and payment destination MUST be verified before production payment.
Destination change MUST suspend affected offers and invalidate grants.
Every invocation MUST pin an immutable offer version.
Payment settlement MUST NOT be treated as delivery or mission proof.
Refund, dispute, and non-delivery processes MUST be defined per offer/adapter.
Provider metadata MUST be treated as untrusted input.
Provider suspension MUST deny new grants while preserving in-flight reconciliation.
Production enablement MUST require a valid core × execution-profile × market tuple.
Certificate MUST pin exact artifact, schemas, execution profile, applicable network/signer, market, and evidence.
Material change or S0 trigger MUST automatically revoke affected scope.
Revocation MUST stop new authority while preserving reconciliation.
Certificate and evidence MUST expire on defined schedules.
Reissue MUST require fresh proof and staged canary.
Every certificate scope MUST have a monotonic authoritative revocation epoch.
Grant, signer, and adapter-dispatch boundaries MUST reject stale, expired, revoked, or unverifiable certificate epochs.
Revocation propagation MUST be measured through component acknowledgements and fail closed beyond certified staleness.
Push notification or cached status MUST NOT be the sole revocation authority.
Certificate issuance MUST enforce required distinct principals across the approval separation-of-duties matrix.
A runtime execution-profile gate result MUST pin the complete controlled-path identity and enforcement strength.
A denied action MUST produce zero external egress.
Credentials MUST remain audience-, tenant-, and action-scoped and outside model context.
Ambiguous post-dispatch outcomes MUST remain unknown and idempotently recoverable.
Bypassable paths MUST be excluded or labeled advisory/mediated.
Revoked authority or certificate epochs MUST be rejected at egress.
Runtime profiles MUST pass SSRF, DNS, redirect, response, and prompt-injection abuse suites.
Every certified external effect MUST have a durable pre-egress action intent.
Controlled paths MUST prevent usable direct credentials and bypass.
MCP tokens MUST be audience-valid and MUST NOT be passed through.
Credentials MUST remain outside agent-visible context and evidence payloads.
SSRF and unbounded request/response behavior MUST be blocked.
Post-submit uncertainty MUST return `EXTERNAL_UNKNOWN`.
Enforcement profiles MUST be explicit per path and action class.
Replaying an idempotency key MUST return the existing result or state.
Every request MUST derive tenant and principal from verified credentials.
Privileged human roles MUST use phishing-resistant MFA.
Workload tokens MUST be short-lived and audience-restricted.
No secret or private key MAY enter agent-visible context.
Certified execution paths MUST prevent or explicitly disable direct bypass.
Every signer profile MUST publish a maximum-loss analysis.
Cross-tenant tests MUST cover every persistence and execution layer.
Policy, key, destination, and production-limit widening MUST require separation of duties.
New destructive actions MUST stop when emergency revocation succeeds.
Post-submit ambiguity MUST remain visible and recoverable.
Raw private keys MUST NOT be available to agents, prompts, general API hosts, or logs.
Signing MUST require exact grant, reservation, adapter, and semantic-intent binding.
Every signer profile MUST publish maximum loss for each compromise case.
Cross-tenant signing authority MUST be cryptographically or provider-isolated.
Arbitrary opaque calldata signing MUST be prohibited.
Keys and encrypted material MUST carry version identifiers and tested rotation.
Destination/key/policy widening MUST use dual control.
Signing uncertainty MUST preserve the attempt and reservation.
A live-money signer MUST reject stale or revoked release-certificate epochs at the signing boundary.
Every S0 requirement MUST have negative and failure-path proof.
Money journeys MUST be fault-injected at every ambiguity boundary.
Cross-tenant coverage MUST include every data and execution layer.
Restore MUST prove financial and evidence continuity.
Test evidence MUST pin exact release/profile and expire.
A financial mainnet profile canary MUST externally reconcile before that profile's limit increases.
Every operational state MUST have one canonical addressable route and owning domain.
UI MUST NOT present submitted, unknown, unreconciled, or unverified financial work as complete.
Unknown, reconciliation, evidence, incident, and revocation states MUST expose safe operator actions and prohibited actions.
Information-heavy domain views MUST support filtering, pagination/cursors, stable URLs, and export where applicable.
Drawers MAY simplify focused creation/editing but MUST NOT hide multi-step financial or privilege review.
Auth visual composition MUST remain unchanged unless an approved functional ADR requires a scoped update.
UI actions MUST preserve backend idempotency, authority, certificate, and tenant boundaries.
Every workload MUST have one organization, environment, sponsor, and stable identity.
Credentials MUST NOT be reusable across tenants.
Delegation MUST be attenuating and reconstructable.
Workload tokens MUST be audience-restricted and short-lived.
Credentials and provider secrets MUST NOT enter model-visible context.
Rotation and revocation MUST have tested propagation bounds.
Revoking a parent or emergency epoch MUST invalidate dependent unsubmitted grants.
Orphaned agents MUST be detected and prevented from receiving new authority.
